name: WE-039 Sorrel Basin groundwater allocation (loop_r2 seed)

unclear.text: Trading across sub-basins: K4 allows transfers between wells in the Basin, subject to the Authority's rules on local impacts; the hydrology chapter says impacts are managed by sub-basin.
readings: U1-a: a share may be pumped only from a well in the sub-basin where the parcel that earned it lies
U1-b: a share may be pumped anywhere in the basin; impact rules only set conditions on individual wells

a1.text: Without the cap, pumping would stay near 300,000 af and above 210,000.

a2.text: The cap is enforced against most pumpers: meters, telemetry and satellite checks detect most over-pumping.

a10.text: Detection is weak for some wells, so some pumpers over-pump.

a12.text: Land buyers priced the expected claim to shares from the publication of the draft plan.

a17.text: Some pumpers inflated 2017 to 2021 pumping in anticipation of allocation by history.

a4.text: A lease market forms: transaction costs are low enough for holders to lease to others within a season.
